title: Loaded Potato Pan Pizza with Cheddar, Chives and Soured Cream
changes_from_base: A thick, airy pan crust built with gentle folds replaces the thin round base, topped with paper-thin salted potatoes, onion, rosemary, chilli and cheddar, then finished with chives and a soured cream drizzle; the meat in the original is left out.
summary: Thick, airy pan pizza layered with paper-thin potatoes, onion, rosemary and mature cheddar, finished with chives and a soured cream drizzle.
equipment: rimmed baking tray, about 33 x 45 cm

ingredients.item: yellow waxy-floury potatoes (such as Yukon Gold or Maris Piper), scrubbed
fine sea salt or table salt, for the soaking water (mostly poured away)
fine sea salt or table salt
ingredients.note: about 1 tsp, for the potato topping

steps.title: Make Dough
steps.text: Whisk bread flour (360 g), salt (8 g) and yeast (3 g) in a large bowl, add water (270 ml) and oil (15 ml) and stir hard until no dry flour remains, cover and leave somewhere warm 15 min.

steps.title: Fold
steps.text: With a wet hand lift a section of dough, press it into the middle, give the bowl a quarter turn and repeat 3-6 times until it resists, rest 15 min, fold again, then cover and leave 1-1.5 h until slightly puffy.

steps.title: Pan
steps.text: Oil the tray (33 x 45 cm) with remaining oil (15 ml), turn the dough in it and stretch with fingertips to cover about three quarters, rest 30 min, stretch to the edges, cover and prove 45-60 min.

steps.title: Prepare Potatoes
steps.text: Stir salt (2 tbsp) into warm water (950 ml), slice the potatoes (450 g yellow waxy-floury) very thinly (2-3 mm) and soak them, drain and dry well in a clean tea towel, toss with onion (½ medium, 170 g sliced), oil (15 ml), rosemary (1½ tsp chopped), chilli flakes (½ tsp) and salt (1 tsp).

steps.title: Heat Oven
steps.text: Meanwhile put a shelf (and stone if using) at the bottom and heat the oven to 260 °C.

steps.title: Build and Bake
steps.text: Spread the potato mixture in a single layer over the dough, scatter cheddar (140 g grated), lower the oven to 230 °C and bake on the bottom shelf 25-30 min until bubbling and deep golden underneath (check with a fish slice; move up for 2-4 min if the top is pale).

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Cool briefly, slide onto a rack, scatter chives (3 tbsp chopped) and drizzle with soured cream mixed with milk (60 g soured cream with 1 tbsp milk).

tips: Soak sliced potatoes in salted water to remove excess starch and keep them supple; drain and dry thoroughly to prevent a soggy base
Slice the potatoes as thinly and evenly as you can, ideally on a mandoline with its guard, so they cook through while the crust browns.
Make the soured cream mixture just before serving so it stays cold and doesn't break or separate from the hot pizza
storage: Cool completely, then keep chilled for up to 2 days and reheat in foil in a low oven until hot, then serve. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
